newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Management wins Hungary Dunaferr assets tender.
newsitem.headline: Management wins Hungary Dunaferr assets tender.

text.p: Hungary's state privatisation agency APV Rt said on Thursday that a tender for the management of the Dunaferr steel group's assets was successful and it declared Acel 21 Kft as the winner.
Ten potential investors bought the tender documents but only one bid, that of Acel 21 Kft, was submitted, APV managing director Laszlo Becker told APV's weekly news conference.
The assets management refers to a combined 84.48 percent stake, of which APV holds 60.84 percent while the rest is held by the state assets management directorate.
Acel 21 Kft consists of Dunaferr's management, Becker said.
The winner's role is to ensure the competitive operation of Dunaferr's annual 1.3 million tonnes capacity until the company's privatisation which is not on the agenda now.

In early June Becker said APV was seeking an asset manager for a temporary period until Dunaferr's privatisation came onto the agenda, which he believed would happen only when Dunaferr's currently used technology became obsolete around 2003 to 2005.
